notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
nfs* NSE wildcard runs nfs-ls (lists share contents with permissions/UIDs), nfs-showmount (export list), nfs-statfs (share stats), and rpcinfo in one pass. nfs-ls shows id_rsa files with UIDs without requiring a manual mount — immediate critical finding identification.

=== CHAINING ===
nmap nfs* → nfs-ls reveals sensitive files → nfs-showmount confirms export paths → mount share → UID matching attack → access private keys or sensitive data.
